description: Extended 10-year (2016-2025) JEE Main & JEE Advanced verified PYQ & prep bank across Class 11 & 12 Physics & Chemistry.

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 4 m/s² for 5 seconds. The distance travelled is:
questions.source: JEE Main 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 2

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: The oxidation state of Chromium (Cr) in K2Cr2O7 is:
questions.source: JEE Main 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 7

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Bernoulli's equation for steady, incompressible, non-viscous fluid flow is a statement of conservation of:
questions.explanation: Bernoulli's theorem P + (1/2)ρv² + ρgh = constant represents conservation of mechanical energy per unit volume.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2017 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 9

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For a zero-order reaction, the half-life t1/2 is directly proportional to:
questions.explanation: For zero-order kinetics, t1/2 = [R]0 / (2k), which is directly proportional to initial concentration [R]0.
questions.source: JEE Main 2017 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 3

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The root mean square (rms) speed of ideal gas molecules is proportional to:
questions.explanation: vrms = √(3RT/M) ∝ √T (where T is absolute temperature in Kelvin).
questions.source: JEE Main 2018 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 12

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following aqueous solutions of equal molality (0.1 m) will have the highest boiling point elevation (assuming complete dissociation)?
questions.explanation: ΔTb = i Kb m. van't Hoff factor i: Glucose=1, NaCl=2, CaCl2=3, Al2(SO4)3=5 (highest).
questions.source: JEE Main 2018 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 1

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The magnetic field inside a long straight solenoid carrying current I with n turns per unit length is:
questions.explanation: By Ampere's circuital law, the uniform axial magnetic field inside a long solenoid is B = μ₀nI.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2019 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 4

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For the reaction N2(g) + 3H2(g) ⇌ 2NH3(g), the relation between Kp and Kc is:
questions.explanation: Δng = 2 - (1 + 3) = -2, so Kp = Kc(RT)^Δng = Kc(RT)⁻².
questions.source: JEE Main 2019 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 6

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: According to Stefan-Boltzmann law, the total radiant energy emitted per unit area per second by a blackbody is proportional to:
questions.explanation: Stefan-Boltzmann law states E = σT⁴.
questions.source: JEE Main 2020 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 10

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following is a strong-field ligand in the spectrochemical series?
questions.explanation: In the spectrochemical series, I⁻ < Br⁻ < Cl⁻ < F⁻ < H2O < NH3 < en < CN⁻ < CO; CN⁻ causes large crystal field splitting.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2020 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 5

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Two tuning forks of frequencies 256 Hz and 260 Hz are sounded together. The beat frequency heard is:
questions.explanation: Beat frequency fbeat = |f₁ - f₂| = |260 - 256| = 4 Hz.
questions.source: JEE Main 2021 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 14

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which compound undergoes Cannizzaro reaction when heated with concentrated NaOH?
questions.explanation: Cannizzaro reaction occurs in aldehydes having NO α-hydrogen, such as HCHO and benzaldehyde.
questions.source: JEE Main 2021 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 8

questions.subject: physics
questions.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
questions.question: If the kinetic energy K of a free electron is doubled, its de Broglie wavelength λ changes by a factor of:
questions.explanation: λ = h / √(2mK) ∝ 1/√K. Doubling K scales λ by 1/√2.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2022 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 11

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: According to Faraday's first law, the mass of substance deposited at an electrode is directly proportional to:

options.B: Quantity of electricity (charge Q = It) passed

questions.explanation: W = Z Q = Z I t; deposited mass is proportional to total electric charge passed.
questions.source: JEE Main 2022 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 2

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The elastic potential energy stored per unit volume (energy density) in a stretched wire is:
questions.explanation: Elastic potential energy density u = (1/2) × Stress × Strain = (1/2) Y (Strain)².
questions.source: JEE Main 2023 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 8

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.chapter: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: What is the hybridisation of each carbon atom in ethyne (HC≡CH)?
questions.explanation: Each carbon in ethyne forms 2 sigma bonds and 2 pi bonds, corresponding to sp hybridisation (linear, 180°).
questions.source: JEE Main 2023 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 8

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Which class of magnetic materials has a small, negative magnetic susceptibility (χ < 0) and is weakly repelled by a magnetic field?
questions.explanation: Diamagnetic substances (e.g., Bi, Cu, water) have -1 ≤ χ < 0 and move from stronger to weaker magnetic fields.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2024 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 5

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Treating phenol with chloroform (CHCl3) in aqueous NaOH followed by acidification introduces a -CHO group at the ortho position. This reaction is:
questions.explanation: The Reimer-Tiemann reaction converts phenol to salicylaldehyde via dichlorocarbene (:CCl2) intermediate.
questions.source: JEE Main 2024 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 7

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: In a balanced Wheatstone bridge with resistors P, Q, R, S, no current flows through the galvanometer when:
questions.explanation: Bridge balance requires equal potentials at the two midpoints, giving P/Q = R/S.
questions.source: JEE Main 2025 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 3

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For an ideal gas, the relationship between molar heat capacities at constant pressure (Cp) and constant volume (Cv) is:
questions.explanation: Mayer's relation for 1 mole of an ideal gas is Cp - Cv = R.
questions.source: JEE Main 2025 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 5

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: According to Kepler's third law of planetary motion, the square of the time period T of revolution is proportional to:
questions.explanation: Kepler's law of periods states T² ∝ r³ (semi-major axis cubed).
questions.source: JEE Main 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 7

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The energy U stored in a capacitor of capacitance C charged to potential difference V is:
questions.source: JEE Main 2017 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 2

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The magnetic energy stored in an inductor of self-inductance L carrying steady current I is:
questions.explanation: Work done against back emf builds magnetic energy U = (1/2)LI².
questions.source: JEE Main 2018 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 6

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: According to Brewster's law, when unpolarised light is incident at the polarising angle ip on a medium of refractive index n, then:
questions.explanation: At Brewster's angle, reflected and refracted rays are perpendicular, giving tan ip = n.
questions.source: JEE Main 2019 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 10

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: To convert pure silicon into an n-type semiconductor, it is doped with a small amount of:
questions.explanation: Pentavalent donor atoms provide extra free electrons as majority carriers in n-type semiconductors.
questions.source: JEE Main 2020 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 14

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Lanthanoid contraction across the 4f series is primarily caused by:
questions.explanation: 4f electrons have diffuse shapes and shield the increasing nuclear charge very poorly, causing steady decrease in atomic/ionic radii.
questions.source: JEE Main 2021 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 4

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: In the Finkelstein reaction, alkyl bromides or chlorides are converted into alkyl iodides using:
questions.explanation: R-X + NaI (dry acetone) → R-I + NaX↓ (NaCl/NaBr precipitates in dry acetone, driving equilibrium forward).
questions.source: JEE Main 2022 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 6

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Reductive ozonolysis (O3 followed by Zn/H2O) of ethene (CH2=CH2) yields:
questions.explanation: Cleaving the C=C double bond of CH2=CH2 with O3 and Zn/H2O produces 2 HCHO.
questions.source: JEE Main 2023 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 9

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: How many moles of CO2 are produced when 1 mole of CH4 is completely combusted in excess O2?
questions.explanation: CH4 + 2O2 → CO2 + 2H2O; 1 mole CH4 yields 1 mole CO2.
questions.source: JEE Main 2024 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 1

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Total Internal Reflection (TIR) occurs when light travels from:

options.A: Rarer to denser medium at any angle
options.B: Denser to rarer medium with angle of incidence greater than critical angle
options.C: Denser to rarer medium at angle less than critical angle

questions.explanation: TIR requires light travelling from an optically denser to a rarer medium with i > ic (where sin ic = n2/n1).
questions.source: JEE Main 2025 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 9
